type: A trapezium dimension model
stem: A trapezium has parallel sides $(x+2)$ cm and $(3x-2)$ cm and perpendicular height $x$ cm, where $x>2/3$. Its area is $32\text{ cm}^2$.

parts.text: Show that $2x^2=32$.
parts.explanation: 平行边相加后常数抵消。

scheme.text: 平行边相加后常数抵消。

parts.text: Find all three dimensions.
parts.explanation: 取正平方根并核对允许域。

scheme.text: 取正平方根并核对允许域。

parts.text: Find the allowable $x$ for which the area is at most $50\text{ cm}^2$.
parts.explanation: 2x²≤50且x正，结合边长限制。

parts.text: Explain why the negative root of the area equation is unsuitable.
parts.answer: x=−4使高度和一条边为负，不是有效几何尺寸。
parts.explanation: 尺寸限制是模型条件，不应仅以根号默认正号省略。
